args.note: I've written the cold read of all three issues to cold-read.md. My verdicts: I'd keep reading through Issue 01 and want Issue 02, I'd put Issue 02 down at page 22, I'd put Issue 03 down at page 41, and I wouldn't buy a next book. The birthday-debt page (p2), the robot B11 and the dog TJ were what pulled me in. What lost me: Ada and Mera are never introduced, and the names Mara and Mera kept getting mixed up in my head. The dad keeps turning into someone new (broke gambler, then a patent genius, then one of three people who signed emergency powers). The Covenant bands on pp41–42 confused me most of all. The book never says whether Keel gets its water back. A lot of the dialogue is short two-part sayings that all sound the same, and skeptical students may read that as AI-written.
